lead.title: 1nhaler (Scotland) raises £2.2M led by Archangels for its single-use cardboard inhaler
lead.deck: The Scottish spin-off is developing a credit-card-sized dry-powder inhaler paired with salbutamol (asthma), with Scottish Enterprise and BBB Investments in the round. Proceeds fund technology transfer to a contract manufacturer and the start of a clinical trial, with a regulatory filing targeted for late 2027.

milestone.title: Abbott presents one-year VERITAS results for the Amulet 360 left atrial appendage occluder at TCT 2026
milestone.summary: Complete appendage closure in 96.3% of patients, over 98% free from ischemic stroke or clot-related complications and over 99% free from pericardial effusion; data published in JACC: Cardiovascular Interventions.
milestone.why: CE-marked since August 2026 but not yet cleared in the US, Amulet 360 reaches Europe first, up against Boston Scientific's Watchman (~80% of the US market in 2025): a real-world test for LAAO challengers.

deal.thesis: Blackstone co-funds development of VITALYST, a temporary transvalvular heart pump for post-infarction cardiogenic shock (>4 L/min flow, magnetically driven impeller with no purge system). Healthcare private equity is funding a large group's device R&D: a valuation signal for the pVAD segment.

brefsIntl.title: HistoSonics wins Singapore HSA clearance for its Edison histotripsy system
brefsIntl.summary: Already CE-marked in July 2026 and FDA-authorized (De Novo, 2023), Edison now opens up Asia-Pacific; the company plans to leverage the clearance to speed up Malaysia, Thailand, Australia and the Philippines.

brefsIntl.title: StimCardio raises $30M Series A led by Metis Medtech for its wearable neurostimulation band after AF ablation
brefsIntl.summary: Rhyvive non-invasively stimulates the median nerve; the NeuroPulse 1 sham-controlled pilot reduced post-ablation recurrences. Funds back the NeuroPulse 2 pivotal trial and preparation of an FDA De Novo request.

brefsIntl.title: FDA clears Roche's cobas eplex RP3 respiratory panel
brefsIntl.summary: The panel detects up to 19 viral and bacterial targets (RSV, influenza, SARS-CoV-2) in under two hours on the automated cobas eplex system, succeeding RP2 under emergency use.

word.definition: A mini-pump mounted on a catheter, inserted through an artery, that temporarily helps the left ventricle push blood when the heart is failing.

parts.label: Catheter
parts.role: the access route through the artery

how.t: The catheter is threaded through the femoral artery and positioned across the aortic valve.
The impeller draws blood from the left ventricle and pushes it into the aorta, unloading the heart.
Once the heart recovers or the procedure ends, the pump is removed.

word.why: Cardiogenic shock and high-risk PCI are underserved markets dominated by Impella: Boston Scientific is co-funding VITALYST with Blackstone ($455M), and rounds at several challengers (Novo Holdings leading) show capital is following.

startups.name: Magenta Medical
startups.use: Elevate pump, billed as the world's smallest; $105M raised in July 2024 led by Novo Holdings for US trials

startups.name: Supira Medical
startups.use: Catheter-based ventricular pump; $120M Series E (Novo Holdings, Qatar Investment Authority) for a US pivotal study

startups.name: Procyrion
startups.use: Aortix, a pump placed in the descending aorta for acute heart failure; DRAIN-HF pivotal trial ongoing, FDA Breakthrough designation
